text:
Maya: Heads up — we saw ~120 leads unassigned yesterday evening because enrichment took >15s and HubSpot timed out the RR claim. Need quick decision: hold assignment until enrichment returns (short TTL) or fallback immediately to overflow pool? :thinking:

Omar: Is this the same spike tied to the EU campaign? I think payloads were bigger (company size + 3rd party enrich). If we hold, ETA on infra changes?

Maya: Yes EU drip. Holding would be a config change in our routing service + small HS rule change. No infra deploy if we just tweak the TTL and routing priority.

Jules: From SDR side — holding is fine for 10s but not much longer. If claim blocked, we lose the lead to other tools and it's messier. Can we do 10s hold + immediate overflow fallback?

Nina: Agree. Also let's not double-assign when enrichment returns late. Need idempotent claim flow.

Devon: I can add a gating flag in the intake lambda to mark "pending_enrich" and update the claim worker to prefer pending leads for first pass. Minimal code change, no deploy if we toggle feature flag.

Devon: Pseudo-rule I was thinking:
```
if (lead.needsEnrich) {
  lead.state = 'pending_enrich'
  setTTL(lead, 10s) // then move to overflow pool
} else {
  assignRoundRobin(lead)
}
```

Omar: Two other asks: 1) add small jitter to RR so a hot SDR doesn't get stomped when batch retries happen, 2) metric for "lead moved to overflow after enrich timeout" so ops can see frequency.

Maya: Good call. Metric + alert if overflow moves >5/min. Jitter default 200-800ms?

Jules: 200-800ms sounds fine. Also can we have an audit field on the lead: `claimed_at` vs `final_assigned_at` so we know latency impact for sales ops?

Nina: And please make sure Salesforce sync doesn't create duplicate Opportunities if `claimed_at` changes. We should only create SF object once `final_assigned_at` exists.

Devon: I'll implement the pending_enrich flag + TTL and the RR jitter. Will push a feature-flagged PR and add metrics: `lead.overflows.enrich_timeout` + `lead.assign.latency_ms`.

Maya: Awesome. Can someone own the HS rule change to make HubSpot hold assignment for 10s when `pending_enrich` present? We need a webhook mapping update.

Omar: I'll own the HubSpot mapping and coordinate with CS sync. Will update this thread when the webhook change is live.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: branch `pending-enrich-gate` -> staging at 2024-06-25T02:30Z (ETA 2m). Monitor `lead.overflows.enrich_timeout` post-deploy.

Maya: Thanks all — plan: implement gating + TTL=10s, RR jitter=200-800ms, overflow fallback, metrics + HS webhook update. Followups: Omar to update HS, Devon to open PR, Nina to verify SF dedupe flow, Jules to validate SDR UX.

Jules: I'll test on the staging campaign once deploy-bot confirms. :thumbsup:
